BiblicalUsage: Chadduwd is a sharp point, and it appears once, under Leviathan: sharp stones are under him, and he spreads sharp pointed things upon the mire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sharp stones under Leviathan are there to tell Job what he cannot do — no man tames what God made untamable.
